'''Baby blue dragons''' are small blue dragons that are found in [[Taverley Dungeon]] and are the weakest attackable baby [[chromatic dragons]]. Players require the [[dusty key]] to open the gate leading to the blue dragons or have 70 [[Agility]] to use the pipe shortcut. They attack with magic, which is fairly accurate. Unlike their [[blue dragon|adult forms]], they do not breathe [[dragonfire]].

Due to the relatively high [[Prayer]] experience gained from their bones in comparison to their toughness to defeat, they are often killed for their bones. Each burial of baby dragon bones grants 30 Prayer experience; for reference, [[dragon bones]] grant 72, and [[big bones]] grant 15. Blue and baby blue dragons respawn at the rate of around 20 seconds.

Baby blue dragons may be killed by players who have received blue dragons as a [[Slayer]] assignment but do not wish to kill adult blue dragons, giving 18.8 Slayer experience each. Their bones also provide 30 [[Prayer]] experience each and can be set to be automatically buried by the [[bonecrusher]]. Lower-levelled players who wish to kill baby blue dragons without being attacked by higher-levelled blue dragons can find them in Taverley Dungeon near three fishing spots for [[lava eel]]s. These are south of the Agility shortcut and the [[small obelisk]] found near to the mother blue dragons.

==Trivia==
* When fighting the more southern baby blue dragons in the Taverley Dungeon, players will experience a glitch which seems to cause the dragon to be cut off graphically.
* During Bot-Nuking week, baby blue dragons were one of the monsters to have an temporarily increased respawn rate.
